# healthchecks_check (Resource)

Manages a Healthchecks check using the Management API v3. The provider obtains a project read-write API key via project settings when necessary.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `desc` (String)

- `tags` (List of String)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `tz` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ping_url` (String)
- `status` (String)
